title: Jenang Gemi actual-source-to-MCP read acceptance matrix
coverage_boundary: Static canonical dashboard PHP/SQL declarations and readers, all API index consumers, file readsites, current reviewed projection/report registries, known ingest repository and pinned Store Ops source contracts. This does not assert production availability, complete stored history, full screen parity or callable client catalog.

classifications.mapped: Safe projection or canonical adapter implemented locally, not proof of live usability.
classifications.projection_needs_semantic: Some facts may be mapped, but precise canonical calculation or bounded passive file adapter remains a concrete implementation gap.
classifications.external_reader_blocked: Real external source; no verified deployed passive sanitized reader yet. Do not alias it to a local database or substitute zero.
classifications.intentionally_excluded: Security, identifiable data, private proof, privileged control or non-business presentation/internal metadata excluded explicitly.

release_acceptance: No source query missing/denied/stale result converted into zero.
Each mapped source verified at runtime for availability and returned schema before claiming live usability.
Only approved dashboard read scope and existing account partitions; finance-recipient reporting retains separate scope/allowlist.
Actual client tools and parameter schemas must reflect server registry; context advertising a name is insufficient.
All computed values use canonical helpers with source/date/units/freshness and limitations.
Remote bridge requires verified deployed passive header-authenticated endpoint; no credential creation or scope expansion.

authorization.dashboard: Existing approved all-configured business dashboard read families; no new family granted by inventory.
authorization.accounts: Explicit account_key/source_account/parent scope joins are enforced where available; unpartitioned aggregate scope is declared. No account=all broadening beyond configured accounts.
authorization.brands: Existing legacy product brand filter is not the same as all-configured dashboard business-source grant. Safe cross-brand dashboard definitions do not add a new credential or grant.
authorization.recipients: Named allocation tool still requires finance scope and saved recipient allowlist. Branch and Brent remain distinct.
authorization.excluded: Credentials, security state, identifiable customer/employee contacts, private document contents, arbitrary raw payloads, and unrestricted SQL/writes.
